title: Is the Hard-Label Cryptanalytic Model Extraction Really Polynomial?
abstract: arXiv:2510.06692v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have attracted significant attention, and their internal models are now considered valuable intellectual assets. Extracting such a model via oracle access to a DNN is conceptually similar to extracting a secret key from a block cipher. Consequently, cryptanalytic techniques, particularly differential-like attacks, have been actively explored. ReLU-based DNNs are the most common and widely deployed architectures. While early works (e.g., Crypto 2020, Eurocrypt 2024) assume access to exact output logits, which are typically not exposed, more recent works (e.g., Asiacrypt 2024, Eurocrypt 2025) focus on the hard-label setting, where only the final classification result (e.g., "dog" or "car") is available. translated_title: 硬标签密码分析模型提取真的是多项式复杂度的吗？
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络（DNNs）已引起广泛关注，其内部模型如今被视为宝贵的知识产权。通过Oracle访问DNN来提取此类模型，在概念上类似于从分组密码中提取密钥。因此，密码分析技术，特别是差分类攻击，已被积极探索。基于ReLU的DNN是最常见且广泛部署的架构。早期工作（如Crypto 2020、Eurocrypt 2024）假设可以访问精确的输出logits，但这些通常不对外公开；而更近期的工作（如Asiacrypt 2024、Eurocrypt 2025）则聚焦于硬标签设置，即仅可获得最终分类结果（例如“狗”或“汽车”）。值得注意的是，Carlini等人（Eurocrypt 2025）表明，即使在这种受限设置下，模型提取也可以在多项式时间内实现。在本文中，我们展示了他们攻击背后的一个关键假设。
tldr: 本文揭示了硬标签密码分析模型提取攻击中一个关键假设的缺陷，质疑其多项式复杂度的可行性。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a flaw in a key assumption underlying hard-label cryptanalytic model extraction attacks, questioning their polynomial-time feasibility.
